ihda:notice:c9fec879f825.summary: IHDA will hold a TEFRA public hearing on October 15, 2026 on issuing up to $500,000,000 in mortgage revenue bonds (2026 Series LMNO) over three years. Proceeds would finance qualifying mortgage loans, down payment and closing cost assistance, and refund prior bonds.

ihda:notice:f38be4c0418c.relevance_reason: The Qualified Allocation Plan sets how Illinois awards Low-Income Housing Tax Credits for affordable housing development.
ihda:notice:f38be4c0418c.summary: IHDA released its draft 2027-2028 Low-Income Housing Tax Credit Qualified Allocation Plan for public comment. A hybrid public hearing is set for June 8, 2026, and written comments are due by 5:00 P.M. on June 15, 2026.
